name: direct-thread-delete
description: Browse, select, and permanently delete Codex threads while keeping the Desktop sidebar synchronized.

interface.longDescription: Browse, search, filter, paginate, select, and permanently delete active or archived Codex tasks in a polished project-tree interface. A single confirmed action first synchronizes the Desktop sidebar through Codex, then permanently deletes the task through the supported app-server protocol.
defaultPrompt: Open the Codex task deletion manager.
Synchronize the sidebar and permanently delete a Codex task by UUID.
